description: Owner of an NFT on Avalanche: the wallet that holds one ERC-721 token id right now (ownerOf), plus the collection's name and symbol. Use to verify who holds an NFT before a trade, a mint gate or an airdrop; for how many a wallet holds use avax_nft_balance, for the token's metadata avax_nft_metadata. A missing contract is 404, a token that does not exist 422, both uncharged. Example: contract=0x655C406EBFa14EE2006250925e54ec43AD184f8B, tokenId=1. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: avax_nft_owner
title: NFT owner, Avalanche
